description: check_names closure (line 1420) takes require_match: bool where false=excluded-check and true=permitted-check. Call sites check_names(nc_excluded.as_slice(), false) and check_names(permitted.as_slice(), true) are not self-documenting — a reader must visit the closure definition to understand the polarity. Fix: split into two closures, check_excluded and check_permitted, or name the parameter mode: Mode with enum Mode { Excluded, Permitted }. Two closures are simplest since the bodies barely overlap.
notes: SEC7: This code is pre-existing, not introduced by PKIX-aoe. The bool flag anti-pattern is real but the function is a private internal closure called exactly twice in one function — the cost of misreading is low and bounded. Labeled opinion; out of scope for this review pass.
title: check_names boolean flag: replace with two named closures
